subject: Supply chain evidence lifecycle & subprocessor delivery roadmap
messages:
From: Eva Santos <eva.santos@healthbridge.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ward <tom.ward@healthbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Subprocessor roster + evidence timeline for HealthBridge assessment

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for taking this on. We are kicking off the vendor review for Q2 and need two things from Redwood to complete our control mapping: (1) a current subprocessor roster with residency and access scope, and (2) a proposed delivery timeline for the evidence bundle (SOC2 sections, KMS residency attestation, CAIQ answers and any recent pen test reports).

High-level constraints: our procurement deadline is 2027-05-18 and our audit team needs the bundle at least two business days before that to run it through their intake. Can you confirm whether you can: 1) provide the roster as a CSV, with columns for name, purpose, country, SOC2 status, and KMS access; and 2) provide a recommended staging plan for evidence delivery (ideally a 2-3 week window with milestones)?

We prefer PDFs/XLSX for artefacts and a single place to land everything (DocuSign/secure share or S3 link). If there are known gaps, flag them so our audit team can scope compensating controls.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — copying Tom (security) for any technical clarifications.

Thanks,
Eva
Vendor Security Manager
HealthBridge Medical

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Subprocessor roster + evidence timeline for HealthBridge assessment

Eva — thanks for the note. We can meet your timeline. Attached is a preliminary subprocessor roster CSV and a draft evidence delivery roadmap. High-level plan:

- Day 0 (today): deliver subprocessor roster CSV (columns: vendor, purpose, country, data access scope, SOC2 attestation date, KMS involvement flag) — see attachment redwood-subprocessors-20270504.csv
- Day 2: provide CAIQ/consumption-level answers for controls related to data handling and key management
- Day 5: deliver SOC2 artifact index (report summary + redacted report if NDA/contract covers it)
- Day 8-12: KMS residency attestation + key custody diagrams + sample telemetry screenshots
- Day 14: pen test summary and any outstanding items in a consolidated evidence bundle (supplychain-evidence-plan-v1.pdf)

Known caveats: our redaction policy prevents providing raw logs; we can provide sanitized telemetry and signed attestation statements. If you need unredacted artifacts, we will need a signed NDA and evidence access agreement.

I'll be the primary contact for logistics; Marissa (security) will own content review and Ben (ops) will coordinate S3/links. Please confirm whether HealthBridge prefers DocuSign collection or a temporary S3 share.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of GRC Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- redwood-subprocessors-20270504.csv (CSV stub: 58 rows, includes vendor name, purpose, country, access scope, SOC2 status, KMS flag)
- supplychain-evidence-plan-v1.pdf (PDF stub: 4-page timeline and milestone checklist)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 15:26:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Subprocessor roster + evidence timeline for HealthBridge assessment

Eva — quick follow-up questions after reviewing the CSV and roadmap:

1) KMS/residency: Can you confirm whether your control mapping requires per-subprocessor KMS provenance (i.e., which subprocessor holds plaintext keys vs. uses envelope encryption)? We can provide an ownership matrix but will need to redact some provider-level configs.

2) SOC2 scope: Are you requesting full reports for all subprocessors listed as "SOC2: yes" or is an attestation date + scope sufficient for initial intake? If you require copies, we'll need to route through Legal for vendor release approvals (adds ~3 business days).

3) CAIQ depth: for the CAIQ deliverable, do you want a full CAIQ questionnaire returned or a tailored set of answers mapped to your high-priority controls? We recommend the tailored set to hit your procurement deadline.

Proposed: we stage the delivery — CSV and tailored CAIQ answers first, then SOC2 index and KMS diagrams, and finally deeper artefacts on request. If HealthBridge can accept the staged approach we can meet your 05/18 procurement cut.

FYI: Ben will provision a temporary, access-controlled S3 bucket and create pre-signed links for the artefacts. Those links will be time-limited and logged.

Marissa Cole
Principal Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Marissa / Stephanie — thanks, that staged approach works for us. A couple quick confirmations:

- KMS provenance: attestation date + matrix is fine for intake. If we need deeper key flow diagrams we will flag during intake and expect the 3-business-day review for release.
- SOC2: please provide the attestation date + scope for each vendor; we will request copies only for critical handlers (data storage, tokenization).
- CAIQ: tailored CAIQ mapped to our high-priority controls is ideal. Please prioritize controls around data residency, encryption-in-transit, encryption-at-rest, and incident response.

We'll accept a staged deliverable as: CSV + tailored CAIQ answers by EOD 2027-05-06, SOC2 index by 2027-05-10, KMS attestation and diagrams by 2027-05-12, and the consolidated bundle by 2027-05-14. If that schedule looks good, please send the S3 link or DocuSign envelope for secure delivery.

I'll loop Procurement if we need contract-level releases for SOC2 reports.

Tom Ward
Sr. Director, Vendor Risk
HealthBridge Medical
